[SWS_DM_01025] Event status bit transitions triggered by test re- sults
⌈
The DM shall process the Event status bits triggered by the test results
(kPassed or kFailed) reported via the function ara::diag::Monitor::Report-
MonitorAction of the corresponding ara::diag::Monitor instance.
Here,
kPassed shall be used as "TestResult [Passed]" and kFailed as "TestResult [Failed]"
as described in [ISO 14229-1] Annex D.2.
⌋
